basic_info.description: Step into sleek city living in this modern 2-bedroom, 2-bath corner condo (1,185 sq. ft. per MLS) with floor-to-ceiling windows framing sweeping San Francisco skyline views. Built in 2014, this light-drenched home features an open floor plan, wood floors, and a stylish kitchen with gas stovetop  perfect for entertaining or quiet nights in. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and en-suite bath, while the second bedroom is ideal for guests or a home office.  Lifestyle perks abound: 1-car garage parking, solar-friendly building, and luxury amenities including a rooftop deck with panoramic views, interior courtyard, and bike storage. With onsite security and attended lobby, convenience meets peace of mind.  Boasting a near-perfect Walk Score (98), Transit Score (100), and Bike Score (83), this location places you steps from Whole Foods, Safeway, parks, and some of the city's best dining and culture. This is San Francisco living at its most vibrant.
